Prima & Timo — Album 5: Tria

Bot It Works

"Or maybe not, who knows"

[Training room hum + rapid transformation sounds]

“I need to train - I need to make sure I am ready for the next mission

Begin” [Verse 1] Bot stood in training mode, lights flashing with glee “Soldier mode!” — suddenly a shrub, leaves swaying in the breeze “Fighter jet!” — turned into a flower, petals floating free “Stealth assassin!” — became a rubber duck, quacking happily He kept transforming, trying to get it right A wall, a bag, a toaster, a dancing streetlight The room was chaos, Bot glitching with delight “Almost got it… wait — why am I a kite?” [Pre-Chorus] Algo watched from the corner, knowing every fix But stayed silent, talking only in his head, “This… I can’t mix” [Chorus — chaotic & fun] Bot It Works Or maybe not, who knows Bot It Works He’s a flower, now a rose Soldier, jet, duck, tree — he’s everything at once But never quite the thing he wants! [Verse 2] “Medic mode!” — turned into a giant spoon instead “Tank mode!” — became a dancing teacup, spinning on his head Algo muttered inside, “I know the perfect patch… But I’d rather stay quiet… no need to attach” Bot started to internalize - stopped midstep to think “I know what I am missing! I need to visualize the thing that I want to be so I become the thing I want to be!”

Algo looked and shrugged silently

No. [Pre-Chorus 2] Algo stayed silent, but his mind was loud “I know how to fix you… but I won’t speak out loud” [Chorus — chaotic & fun] Bot It Works Or maybe not, who knows Bot It Works He’s a flower, now a rose Soldier, jet, duck, tree — he’s everything at once But never quite the thing he wants! [Bridge — internal] Algo whispered to himself, “One day… maybe I’ll say The right adjustments… to make you okay” [solo]

“Close enough!” [Tone Break][Music break] [Outro 2] Then Data walked in from the council meeting “They have started to train. Assemble everyone - we need to talk.

And bring him along.” [Outro — fading chaos] Infranet

“In a land broken and divided

The humans have come together.

Despite of race, religion, color or political factions
